description: Unofficial epic8 package of minipro by Valentin Dudouyt and David Griffith, the XGecu TL866 programmer software. Flash 8-bit PIC from pio run -t upload

license.name: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later

notes: GPL-3.0: the release carries the exact source tarball the binary was built from. libusb (LGPL-2.1) rides as a shared library under lib/, never linked statically, so a user can relink it. infoic.xml and logicic.xml are the device databases; the binary reads them from MINIPRO_HOME or its compiled-in share dir, so the caller exports MINIPRO_HOME=<package>/share/minipro. algorithm.xml is generated by the upstream dump-alg script and is not needed to program a part, so it is not shipped. The windows_amd64 binary cross-compiles with mingw-w64 against the WinUSB backend, with zlib held statically so no extra DLL ships.
